title: Onboarding + Exit Signal Framework and Triage Checks
content:
Purpose:
This is a lightweight operational playbook for early onboarding triage and standardized 'exit signals' that trigger either targeted remediation (mentor + skills plan) or an offboarding conversation. Aim: reduce guesswork in weeks 0–12 and give managers clear, repeatable steps so people-ops interventions are faster and less subjective.

Scope:
Applies to all IC and associate-level hires in Eng, Product, and Solutions (exceptions noted below). Does NOT replace formal performance management processes — it sits upstream and focuses on the first 90 days.

Quick summary of outcomes we want:
- Faster detection of role mismatch or support gaps
- Clear remediation paths (14/30/60 day micro-sprints)
- Documented handoffs and evidence for later HR decisions
- Better manager + mentor consistency across teams

Signals that should trigger immediate triage (exit-signal candidates):
- Repeated missed commitments on core onramp tasks after two retries (e.g., unable to complete assigned onboarding PRs, fails to reproduce basic infra test)
- Inability to demonstrate required baseline skills after structured pairing sessions (see rubric below)
- Recurrent behavioral red flags: repeated missed 1:1s, lack of responsiveness to asynchronous feedback, or pattern of escalating interpersonal friction escalated to manager+people-ops
- Attendance gaps without documentation after day 14

Triage owner mapping:
- Day 0–14: Manager + assigned mentor -> People Ops notified if signal present (JIRA ONB- triage ticket)
- Day 15–30: Manager + People Ops + Mentor -> Rapid remediation plan documented
- Day 31–60: Manager + People Ops (case review) -> Decide continue remediation vs. start offboarding process
- Day 61–90: Final decision window; if no measurable progress, engage legal/HR for offboarding checklist

Day-by-day checklist (practical, copyable)
- Day 0: Welcome packet sent, tools access audit (Slack, GitHub, infra), primary mentor assigned, 14-day goals created in source ticket (template: ONB-14-template)
- Day 3: First pairing session recorded, note gaps in basic dev flow or documentation, escalate if blocker persists >48h
- Day 7: Manager 1:1 focused on clarity of role, deliverables for week 2. If >1 blocker, open JIRA ONB-7 with owner and ETA
- Day 14: Mini-eval using the "baseline skills rubric" below. If <60% pass, start 14-day micro-sprint remediation plan (see remediation section)
- Day 30: Formal check-in with People Ops present; review evidence notebook (mentor notes, PR review cadence, test coverage). If still below bar, escalate to extended remediation or start offboarding conversation
- Day 60: If remediation active, run a skills re-eval. If minimal improvement (<10% delta), schedule decision meeting (manager + people ops + hiring manager)
- Day 90: Final impact review; document decision and close loop with candidate.

Baseline skills rubric (use for day 14 & re-evals) - simple numeric checklist (copy into PR comments or 1:1 notes):
- Dev flow: Can clone repo, run tests, create a PR with clear description (0/1)
- Core domain knowledge: Understands top 3 components of their service (0/1)
- Debugging: Can reproduce a customer-seen failure locally or in staging (0/1)
- Communication: Can write a short design note (~1 page) or explain a bugfix in async channel (0/1)
- Collaboration: Did pairing sessions and responded to review feedback within SLA (0/1)
Scoring guidance: 4-5 pass, 2-3 conditional pass (remediation required), 0-1 fail -> consider exit signal

Remediation playbook (14-day micro-sprint template)
- Day 0: Define 3 concrete deliverables (small, verifiable). Assign mentor and scheduled daily 30-minute check-ins Mon-Fri.
- Day 7 checkpoint: Deliverable 1 must be finished or blocker triaged to owner. Document evidence in JIRA ONB-REMED-<name>.
- Day 14 demo: Candidate demos work to manager+mentor, receives written feedback and updated rubric score. If progress >=2 points, continue to 30-day plan; else begin offboarding conversation.
Consequence ladder: coach -> focused remediation -> role move (if available) -> offboarding

Mentor rotation and handoffs:
- Mentors are 0.1–0.2 FTE for first 30 days. We recommend rotating mentor after week 3 if skill mismatch is suspected to give fresh pair perspective.
- Mentor notes must be logged in the candidate's "onboarding evidence" Confluence page (link template above).

Interview rubric adjustments (post-hire feedback loop to hiring):
- Every case that triggers an exit signal should produce a short hiring-feedback memo (1 page) and one concrete hiring rubric item to adjust. Example: "Insufficient infra debugging sample in homework; add request to run a failing test locally."
- People Ops will aggregate these into monthly signals for the hiring committee (JIRA: HIRE-RETRO).

Ticket templates (copyable)
- ONB-7: "Early blockers - <candidate>" -> fields: blocker-summary, impact, mentor-assigned, ETA
- ONB-REMED-<name>: "14-day remediation" -> fields: measurable-deliverables (3), checkin-schedule, evidence-links
- OFFB-INIT: "Offboarding initiation" -> fields: decision-date, stakeholders, legal-notified boolean

Escalation matrix (who to call)
- Day 0–30 issues: Manager -> People Ops (Priya Shah) -> Eng lead if infra-related (Ethan Green)
- Conduct concerns or legal flags: People Ops -> Legal -> CEO/Head of People as needed

Examples (anonymized)
- Case A: New SRE hire repeatedly couldn't access staging. Blocker recorded day 2; mentor escalated day 3; access policy change + new infra walkthrough resolved by day 6 -> no remediation needed.
- Case B: Associate PM couldn't produce spec after 14 days; rubric score 2/5. Remediation plan executed, improvement to 4/5 at day 30 via focused product writing coaching. Role retained.
- Case C: Backend IC consistently missed PR quality thresholds after two remediation attempts; manager + people ops decided to offboard at day 70. Documented hiring-feedback memo created and hiring rubric updated.

Open questions / TODOs:
- Need a standard evidence notebook template (Confluence macro) so managers log the same artifacts. Owner: Diego Morales.
- Determine SLA for mentor response time (proposed: 24h for async, 8h for blockers).
- Automate ONB ticket creation from offer acceptance flow (Eng + People Ops integration)

Appendix: quick copy-paste checklist for managers (one-liner version)
- Day 0: send welcome + tools access check
- Day 3: pairing session note
- Day 7: 1:1 + open ONB-7 if >1 blocker
- Day 14: run rubric; if <60% open ONB-REMED
- Day 30: people-ops check-in
- Day 60: re-eval + decision meeting if no progress
- Day 90: final review

Notes to self (informal)
- Keep this doc short; link to longer templates instead of copying everything.
- We should pilot on 10 hires and track time-to-decision and percentage of cases where remediation avoided offboarding.
- Add a short manager script for difficult conversations (people-ops to draft).
summary: Operational checklist + rubric for early detection of onboarding problems and standard remediation/offboarding flow. Designed to make manager decisions consistent and evidence-based in first 90 days.
